name: techdella/ad-slot
title: Ad slot (tools only)
description: Manual AdSense unit with reserved height and an 'Advertisement' label (§12.2). Renders only on tool pages and the /tools/ hub on the Marketing site, at most 3 per page; nothing elsewhere.

techdella.help: position: result (below the tool result), content (after 'How to use'), sidebar (desktop only). Keep the slot at least 150px away from tool buttons and inputs (AdSense policy): the block adds that margin, so don't place it directly next to the tool form. Unit IDs come from the td_adsense_slots option.
